rationale: The stock has gapped down ~27% on extreme relative volume (11.5x), indicating a significant fundamental catalyst driving aggressive selling. While price is currently at 98.4% of today's range suggesting a short-term bounce attempt, the bid-ask spread of 120+ bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage, and the ATR of $0.068 on 5-minute bars is extremely tight relative to the gap magnitude, making reliable stop placement difficult. The combination of wide spread, unclear post-gap stabilization (only one visible candle of data), and a risk-off macro environment (SPY -1.1%, VIXY +4%) makes the risk/reward unfavorable in either direction at this moment.
